video_title: Mad Max on LeBron: 'It's Time to Go' After Lakers Sweep

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Brooks' courtside antics during Lakers game

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: As former players, we see everything. We're focused on the game, but we see who's in the crowd, what women are there, what rappers are there, what actors are there. And this motherfucker sitting courtside just gleamed up, a whole mouthful of diamonds and a whole chest full of diamonds. So I thought it was funny, bro, to be honest with you. Dylan Brooks is a character.

text_blocks.speaker: Max
text_blocks.text: Yeah, it was funny as hell, yeah. I enjoyed it. I enjoyed it.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' incredible performance despite Lakers' sweep
quotes.quote: Unfortunately, the Lakers went down. Bron's been his fourth time being swept in the playoffs. The others were the 2007 Finals against San Antonio, against the Warriors in the Finals, and then the Nuggets in the Conference Finals, and then last night. 23 years in the league down, still had a great year. And his post-conference, he spoke about wearing a lot of different hats this year. At one point being the third option and then having to move into a second option role, and then with both guys down, being the first option. So when we sit back and look at what this man is still doing for his age and years in the game, it's just absolutely incredible.

quotes.speaker: Max
quotes.summary_phrase: Max believes LeBron James' time with Lakers is over

text_blocks.speaker: Max
text_blocks.text: With the Lakers, hell yeah. His ass. Yeah, LeBron, yeah, he got to go, man. It's time to go. I love LeBron. I love what he's about. I love everything about. But it's time to go, man. If I was LeBron.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Is this him thinking or is this management thinking?

quotes.speaker: Max
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers management's disrespect towards LeBron James
quotes.quote: Just the way the management treated the motherfucker, man. The management, hey, no respect. So they're ready for him to go. Like you said, it's new ownership, so I get it. They got AR, but I mean, there's some people been saying some shit about him too. I think his ass got to go too.

quotes.speaker: Max
quotes.summary_phrase: Debate on keeping LeBron James or Austin Reaves

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: You cleaning house, Max? Are you working for the Lakers?

text_blocks.speaker: Max
text_blocks.text: Yeah, well, I'm going to keep one of the other. I'm going to keep LeBron or I'm going to keep AR. But I think for me, I will keep LeBron and let LeBron finish on up there. And AR, you can get a lot for that motherfucker, man. He's a hot commodity right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Well, you can't, well, AR is a, he's unrestricted, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Max
text_blocks.text: Yeah, but you can sign and trade him.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Yeah, so he's going to get some money. People are talking, you know, close to that 200 range, if not 200.

text_blocks.speaker: Max
text_blocks.text: Hey, you say 200? Get the hell up out of here, man. Max, that's what they're saying, Max. You don't believe it?

quotes.speaker: Max
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves' playoff struggles and defensive targeting

text_blocks.speaker: Max
text_blocks.text: Man, you see how that man got exposed in this playoff, man? That motherfucker, I mean, really, hey, can't guard. They say the man hurt. Man, if you're hurt, man, don't play, man. So I don't want to hear you're hurt.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: No, if you're on the court, there's no excuses.

text_blocks.speaker: Max
text_blocks.text: That's what I'm saying. That's what they used to tell us.

text_blocks.speaker: Nate
text_blocks.text: He played better in the regular season than the postseason last two years.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Oh, really? So yeah, Nate said obviously regular season numbers are a lot different than the postseason. Although he was coming off an injury, he was definitely a target on defense. Defenses are offenses attack the shit out of him.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's consistent performance and team leadership
quotes.quote: To me, that's really the issue with this backcourt, with Luka. Both him and AR are both tremendous offensive weapons. But Luka is somebody that shows up all the time. He don't want to play defense all the time, but he's going to show up in the regular season and the playoffs. I think the one thing Austin has riding for him is Luka wants him back. We know that this is Luka's team now, respectfully to Bron.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' free agency decisions and legacy considerations
quotes.quote: It'll be interesting. Is this LeBron's last game? Does he take a pay cut, and I mean a major pay cut, to stay there and allow them to go out and get some other pieces? Or does he move again? Because to me, it's not a knock, but one of the things in my hierarchy when you rank amongst the greatest is he's had to move around and jump around. Does he jump to another team and try to get, is it a Cleveland? Is it a new team? You hear that the Warriors want to land a LeBron or a Kawhi? So it's interesting to me. You start thinking legacy and, you know, is he going to another team in hopes to get a ring? Is he going back to Cleveland to end it? Or is he going to take a pay cut and stay with the Lakers?

quotes.speaker: Max
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James will not retire, should return to Cleveland

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Do you think it's LeBron's, I mean, I don't think producer Nate wanted to ask, is it LeBron's last game overall? Do you think there's any chance that he walks away from the game after this game?

text_blocks.speaker: Max
text_blocks.text: From the game? From the NBA? Oh, hell no. That's no way. Hell no. Never ever. Bron ain't walking away now. I think he's, I mean, I think LeBron should go back to Cleveland, man. I know he said he don't like Cleveland and some shit I thought he heard, I thought I heard him say sometime in some interview.

quotes.speaker: Max
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James has better chance winning with Cleveland
quotes.quote: Yeah, okay. That damn sure was me. Yeah, but no, but LeBron, I think he should have gone back home, man, finish it on up. Have a better chance of winning with Cleveland than he will with the Lakers. Because I don't think the Lakers are going to do enough next year. I don't know what they're going to do next year. The Lakers, I don't know. I don't know what they're doing over there now.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: D'Angelo Russell's jewelry and lack of focus during playoffs

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: I wonder what they're going to do with dominating.

text_blocks.speaker: Max
text_blocks.text: Oh, well, got to keep him out the Bloods. Got to keep him over there from the Bloods and the Crips and shit. The Bloods and shit, the night photo game.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: You out here gang banging and buying jewelry while you're down 0-3. Crazy work. You out here gang banging. What are we doing? Necklaces.

text_blocks.speaker: Max
text_blocks.text: What are we doing, man? What are we doing? We about to get swept, man. What are we doing?

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: You know what they say? You can't give some of these money.
